messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Pairwise Comparison within different population types nested within sites
parts:
Motia,

 

The warning cannot be removed, and is telling you that within the design you specified, you have some missing components or redundancies. I suspect that you have some sites with only one poptype. That would cause the warning, which is simply telling you that some components of the model you specified cannot be examined.

 

Biology does that to us sometimes…


Dean
